title: Benfica celebrate third consecutive Liga Betclic title
description: Benfica - FC Porto 83-76 Benfica celebrated the third consecutive Liga Betclic title. They overcame FC Porto at home court tonight to complete the sweep of the championship series and to repeat as the champions. FC Porto was trailing by 6 points at halftime but managed to get 3-point lead after three quarters before a 27-17 charge of Benfica, which allowed them to win the game. 25 personal fouls committed by FC Porto helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a great evening for American Trey Drechsel (198-1996, college: GCU, agency: Worldwide SM) who led his team to a victory scoring 23 points and 6 rebounds. His fellow American import guard Aaron Broussard (196-1990, college: Seattle, agency: Worldwide SM) helped adding 21 points and 6 rebounds. Five Benfica players scored in double figures.
